Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: full-screen MOBILE landing background for PR-SIM, a presentation rehearsal app. Tall portrait photograph, 9:19.5 aspect ratio, target 1170x2532.
Create a striking real architectural / live-event editorial photograph of an empty prestigious presentation stage in a dark auditorium seconds before a keynote. Strict black-and-white fine-art photographic treatment. Deep charcoal velvet acoustic curtains, a single sculptural black lectern with a slender gooseneck microphone, brilliant hard white stage lights cutting diagonally through faint natural atmospheric haze, tactile stage floor, a few out-of-focus dark audience seats at edges. Cinematic, powerful, confident, credible real venue rather than CGI or sci-fi. High tonal contrast, silver highlights, dramatic luminous stage against near-black curtains, rich blacks with texture. Camera from the audience, 50mm natural perspective. No people.
Composition for overlaid website UI: top 0–42% is very dark, uninterrupted curtain / shadow negative space, especially top 12% for a white logo and navigation, and 15–40% for a white headline. No lights, bright lines, ceiling fixtures or objects crossing the TOP 12%. Main stage action in 45–80% vertical region. Lectern centered x=50%, top y=61%, foot y=78%, microphone rises to y=57%. A realistic overhead spotlight visible at x=85%, y=43% throws a diagonal volumetric white beam toward lectern, with another subtle sidelight. Brightest floor pool at 72% height. Lower 15% falls back into deep black foreground shadow, calm and uncluttered for a large WHITE start button. Broad breathing room; make the stage photograph visually arresting and immediately legible on a small phone. Entire frame is one real photographic scene, no blank white projection screen, no montage.
Constraints: background photo ONLY, no logo, no text, no letters, no buttons, no graphic UI, no watermark, no people, no colored lighting. Do not make a pale empty meeting room. Maintain actual photographic realism and physically plausible beams and microphone.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.

Create a visually powerful black-and-white editorial PHOTOGRAPH of an empty keynote presentation stage in a dark sophisticated auditorium, seen from audience at natural eye height. Single sculptural black lectern with a delicate real gooseneck microphone stands at x=73%, top y=53%, foot y=78%. Deep charcoal velvet acoustic curtains behind it, tactile floor catching a brilliant silver pool of stage light, hints of softly blurred black audience seats at bottom right. Two actual theater fixtures high on right illuminate lectern with strong diagonal white beams through restrained atmospheric haze. Silver rim highlights on lectern, dramatic cinematic chiaroscuro and deep rich shadow with physical texture. Powerful and inviting: your next stage is waiting. Real 35mm architectural event photography, no CGI.
Composition must preserve web UI: LEFT 48% is mostly uninterrupted deep black curtain and shadow, subtle texture only, no bright beams or furniture, for large WHITE typography and WHITE start button. Entire TOP 12% very dark and clean, no lamps or bright beam lines behind the white logo and navigation. Most photographic drama concentrated on RIGHT half between 24%-85% height: angled lighting, illuminated microphone and lectern, lit stage. Bottom 12% almost black with modest reflected light, allowing white caption text. Preserve depth, actual stage geometry, intentional asymmetry and generous negative space. Stronger contrast and visual impact than a generic meeting room; no giant white projection screen. No people.
Constraints: photo background ONLY, no text, letters, logos, graphic symbols, interface elements, buttons, watermark, colored lights, borders or collage. Monochrome black / charcoal / silver palette.
